description: Defines classes and methods for managing E1AP UE contexts within a 3GPP network implementation, including UE context management, lookup, and ID allocation.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_context
classes.description: Represents an individual UE context in E1AP, managing UE IDs, bearer transactions, and logging.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a collection of UE contexts, providing lookup, addition, removal, and ID allocation functionalities.

methods.name: get_ue_ids
methods.description: Returns the UE IDs associated with this context.

methods.name: update_cu_up_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Updates the CU-UP E1AP ID for the UE and adjusts the logger prefix accordingly.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with a specific CU-CP-UE E1AP ID or UE index exists in the collection.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the UE context based on CU-CP-UE E1AP ID or UE index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses UE context by CU-CP-UE E1AP ID or UE index, asserting existence.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE context with specified UE index and CU-CP-UE E1AP ID.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_gnb_cu_cp_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Allocates and returns the next available GNB-CU-CP-E1AP-UE ID.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Transfers UE context to a new UE index.
